source.name: PaySim mobile money simulation
source.reader: chunked raw schema validation and fingerprinting; compact predictors only

preprocessing.numeric_missing: training median; all-missing columns retained as zero
preprocessing.unknown_categories: training infrequent bucket if present, otherwise all zeros

selection_rationale: Highest validation AP, ties lower warm single p95 latency; candidate AP ties keep first declared candidate. Threshold maximizes validation F1.

confidence_intervals.method: Wilson binomial, 95%; conditional on fitted model and threshold
confidence_intervals.limitation: IID approximation; ignores temporal/entity dependence and training uncertainty. No F1/AP/ROC-AUC confidence intervals or paired significance claims are made.

validation_threshold_analysis.selection_objective: maximum F1; cost illustration does not select the threshold

cost_assumptions.unit: arbitrary illustrative units; not monetary savings

inference_latency.measurement: warm predict_proba; one caller; no API, validation or network overhead
inference_latency.batch_input: validation rows, repeated if fewer than 1000; not independent performance data

test_error_analysis.interpretation: Descriptive test error analysis only; no feature or threshold retuning.

validation_error_analysis.interpretation: Descriptive test error analysis only; no feature or threshold retuning.

resources.measurement: process lifetime high-water RSS; sequential study runs share this process, not per-run allocation

limitations: Independent in-domain training, not cross-dataset transfer validation. Each report is one seed; uncalibrated scores; prevalence and feature availability differ between datasets. Chronological evaluation does not isolate recurring entities. Sampling can omit rare patterns. PaySim is a simulator, not evidence of real credit card fraud performance. IEEE feature availability at decision time requires domain review.
